verdict.rationale: macOS documents a first-party automation tool ('Automate tasks with Shortcuts') and one narrow event-driven feature: Safari Notify Me watches a page for changes such as a price drop or restock and alerts the user. Neither item shows user-defined rules that fire arbitrary actions on system or app events, so support is thin and implied. missing for 10: documented event triggers in Shortcuts (time, app launch, file or device events), user-defined rule conditions mapped to arbitrary actions, in-depth automation docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
